blocks.text: A location template is composed of different attributes that are applied to a location. Locations are created automatically when you deploy Zscaler Cloud Connector or Zscaler Branch Connector on a cloud. To have a location automatically created from a template, you must select a location template when configuring a Cloud Provisioning Template or Branch Configuration Template. To learn more, see Configuring a Cloud Provisioning Template and Configuring a Branch Configuration Template.
Location templates provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure various settings such as Firewall Control, Acceptable Usage Policy (AUP), Caution, Authentication, and XFF Forwarding.
Enforce Bandwidth Control and specify the maximum bandwidth limits for download and upload.
Create a template with preferred default settings that will be enabled for all new locations created using that template.

blocks.text: On the Location Templates page (Infrastructure > Location Management > Location Templates), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all location templates that are configured for your organization.
Name: The name of the template.
Last Modified By: The last admin to modify the template.
Last Modified On: The date and time that the template was last modified.
A default location template is automatically created for your organization. You can view this location template, but you cannot edit it.
